title: Cooperating and Asking Follow-up Questions
summary: Working together, clarifying meaning, and sustaining collaborative conversation.
whyItMatters: Collaboration improves when people clarify responsibilities, ask useful follow-up questions, and confirm shared decisions.

mentalModel.title: Listen for missing information
mentalModel.content: Ask about actor, task, timing, method, reason, or dependency when a plan is incomplete.

mentalModel.title: Close the loop
mentalModel.content: Restate the decision and confirm who will do what by when.

ruleBlocks.title: Ask targeted follow-up questions
ruleBlocks.content: Use Was meinst du genau, Woran denkst du, and Wer kümmert sich darum.

ruleBlocks.title: Offer help with a boundary
ruleBlocks.content: State the task you can take, the time available, and what information you need.

ruleBlocks.title: Summarize agreements
ruleBlocks.content: Use Also, wir halten fest or Dann mache ich and invite correction.

examples.de: Woran müssen wir bei der Anmeldung noch denken?
examples.en: What else do we need to consider for registration?

examples.de: Ich kann mich um den Raum kümmern, brauche aber bis morgen die Teilnehmerzahl.
examples.en: I can take care of the room, but I need the participant count by tomorrow.

examples.de: Wir halten also fest, dass du die Texte prüfst und ich die Bilder auswähle.
examples.en: So we agree that you check the texts and I select the images.

commonMistakes.wrong: Ask only Ja/Nein questions when details are missing.
commonMistakes.reason: Open questions reveal the needed information.
Shared assumptions often create missed work.

comparisons.summary: The theme supplies roles, experience, and project-process vocabulary.
Fixed complements support precise questions and responsibilities.
